answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 148374 Country: Qatar Title: Masbuq leading the remaining rakat of his salah as an Imam Question: I stay in Qatar. We sometimes see here in the mosques that a person joined the jamat (of any obligatory salah) in last rakahs and then after Imam finishes the salah he stands up, he is masbuq now some people again start a jamat behind him, making him Imam. Is it right that a masbuq is becoming an Imam in 2nd Jamat in Masjid. How correct is it? Answer ID: 148374 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 316/299/N=5/1438) According to Hanafi Fiqh, a masbuq (who missed some rak’ah with imam) cannot become imam. Hence it is not correct for a Hanafi to pray behind a masbuq imam, in this case the salah of muqtadi will not be valid. According to Hanafi Fiqh, the second jamah in locality mosque is makrooh; thus no other jamah should be established. وهو – أي: المسبوق – منفرد ...... فيما يقضيه ....... إلا في أربع فكمقتد؛ أحدها لا يجوز الاقتداء به الخ (الدر المختار مع رد المحتار ، كتاب الصلاة ، باب الإمامة ، 2: 346-347 ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند)، ويكره تكرار الجماعة بأذان وإقامة في مسجد محلة لا في مسجد طريق الخ (المصدر السابق، ص 288)، قوله: "ويكره" أي : تحريماً لقول الكافي: لا يجوز، والمجمع: لا يباح ، وشرح الجامع الصغير: إنه بدعة كما في رسالة السندي (رد المحتار). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
